# Skowak

> Skowak is an AI transformation boutique that builds production AI systems for operationally complex, regulated businesses.

Skowak builds production AI systems for operationally complex, regulated businesses. Twenty years turning dense domains into software people actually use.

Skowak works through three engagement tiers built on Evaluation-Driven Design:
nothing counts until it is running in the client's business and their team can
maintain it. Domains: insurance underwriting, federal healthcare data, solar and
energy operations, developer infrastructure, education.

## Engagements

- [AI Opportunity Sprint](https://skowak.com/consulting/#sprint) A 2-3 week fixed-fee engagement that maps where AI can create value in your operation and pressure-tests each candidate against your data, constraints and people before any code is written.
- [Agentic Workflow Redesign](https://skowak.com/consulting/#workflow-redesign) A 4-6 week fixed-scope engagement that redesigns the workflow around an AI system: agent placement, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, escalation paths, and an evaluation framework for every AI-assisted decision point.
- [Embedded Build & Prove Retainer](https://skowak.com/consulting/#retainer) A monthly embedded engagement, minimum three months, in which Skowak designs, builds, instruments and proves a production AI system inside your team, then transfers ownership.

- [AI Consulting](https://skowak.com/consulting/): Three engagement tiers  from a fixed-fee Sprint to an embedded retainer  all built on Evaluation-Driven Design: nothing counts until it's running in your business.
- [Start a conversation](https://skowak.com/contact/): Tell Skowak what you're working on. Every message is read personally  expect a reply within two business days.
- [About](https://skowak.com/about/): Skowak is an AI transformation boutique  twenty years designing and building software for domains that resist it: insurance underwriting, federal healthcare data, solar engineering, developer infrastructure.
- [Home](https://skowak.com/): Skowak builds production AI systems for operationally complex, regulated businesses. Twenty years turning dense domains into software people actually use.
- [Work](https://skowak.com/work/): Selected work: twenty years of turning operationally dense domains into systems people use  complex rules, regulated constraints, measured outcomes.
- [SunPower case study](https://skowak.com/work/sunpower/): Compressing commercial solar design from days to 25 minutes  UX architecture and product design for SunPower's digital platform.
- [Writing](https://skowak.com/writing/): Articles on building production AI systems  the reliability problem, the evaluation problem, and the gap between demos and workflows.
- [Craftal case study](https://skowak.com/work/craftal/): Building a research-based multi-agent product-planning system  custom DSL, RAG pipeline, deterministic verification, and structured planning workflows with human review.
- [Fidelity Life case study](https://skowak.com/work/fidelity-life/): Taking insurance applications from four days to thirty minutes  underwriting, case management, and product configuration for a multi-year transformation.
- [Building reliable systems out of an unreliable ingredient](https://skowak.com/writing/reliable-systems/): LLMs will produce confident wrong answers. The question isn't whether AI makes mistakes  it's whether you can build reliable systems using this unpredictable ingredient.
- [Bitscopic — federal healthcare data case study](https://skowak.com/work/federal-health/): Cutting clinical data review effort by up to 80% for Bitscopic — health-data analysis, reporting, and decision-support interfaces inside a government health system.
